title: Flo Daily Leak Score Spike
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flo:event event=leak_score
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(leak_score) as leak_score by home _time
| where leak_score>70
| sort - leak_score
description: Uses Flo by Moen leak scoring telemetry to monitor days where leak-risk scoring became meaningfully elevated in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for water anomalies before they become a claim, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Flo by Moen leak scoring data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights days where leak-risk scoring became meaningfully elevated so you can spot water anomalies before they become a claim before it becomes annoying.
